svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Step 9 mockup 06: the data widgets
svg.text: 06 · The data widgets: new types, new settings and their states
Each widget alone in a Dashboard box (584 × 384 at 1080p), drawn at 0.7. Names never show unless a zone opts in; history widgets say "Collecting…" until they have 3 hours.
Use case: attendees read them; the organiser picks them per box (mockup 10).
top_games · tonight: player-hours, rank moves for
activity_graph · games: bars in the top game's
voice_rooms: public rooms, counts and arrows
now_playing with names: a zone's opt-in (U4)
Right now on a new peak: the box glows (L7)
